15. 圖中，正八邊形被分為八個完全相同的等腰三角形，且其中四個均塗上陰影。該八邊形的反射對稱軸的數目為
A. 2
B. 4
C. 8
D. 16
reasoning: A regular octagon possesses 8 lines of reflection symmetry: 4 through opposite vertices and 4 through the midpoints of opposite sides. When four of the eight congruent isosceles triangles are shaded in the alternating pattern shown, the axes through opposite vertices map each shaded triangle to an unshaded one, so those axes are no longer symmetries of the whole figure. The only axes that map the set of shaded triangles onto itself are the four axes passing through the midpoints of opposite sides. Therefore the shaded octagon retains 4 reflection symmetries, corresponding to option B.
